description: A small half-buried crypt overgrown with bramble: an entrance, a vestibule, a hall of bones, a side chapel, an ossuary, a false tomb and a hidden crypt. Top-down pixel art game map seen from straight above, one continuous scene, muted earthy palette, soft shading, readable floors and walls, no characters, no creatures, no text, no letters, no numbers, no grid lines, no frame, no logo.
